title: Catch-up
description: What changed while you were away, traced and replayed over the canvas. Its parts stand on the trace overlay (the slot traces): catch_up.changes traces each mark a change touched, in its maker's hue, until it is seen, from the change set the runtime hands it as data (the rows a beat touched as they were and are); catch_up.replay offers what changed since the person last looked and plays it a step at a time, chapters by who made them, island by island. The runtime keeps the store, the projector, the painting and where the person last looked; the parts decide.
